OverviewKey FeaturesSpecifications

Fingerprint entry with indoor visitor viewing

The ELVARO Lighting WDL01 is a WiFi smart mortise door lock with an integrated fingerprint reader, a front keypad, and a wide-angle camera. The 3.5-inch indoor display lets users see who is at the door from inside. Tuya app control is also available, with specific remote functions depending on the supplied configuration.

For installation planning, the illustrated mortise body has a 70 mm backset and a 68 mm distance between the handle spindle and cylinder centers. The indoor and outdoor panels each measure 394 × 75 mm. Send us your door thickness, opening direction, and existing lock dimensions to check fit before ordering samples or specifying the lock for a project.

Product FAQ

What should I check before specifying WDL01?

Send your door thickness, opening direction and existing lock dimensions. The illustrated mortise has a 70 mm backset and 68 mm spindle-to-cylinder center distance; fit must be checked for your door.

What is the indoor screen size?

The supplied product specification describes a 3.5-inch indoor display for viewing visitors from inside.

Can WDL01 be controlled through an app?

Tuya app control is available. Confirm the specific remote functions for the supplied configuration before ordering.

What are the panel dimensions?

The indoor and outdoor panels each measure 394 × 75 mm.

Which finishes are shown?

The supplied product images show brown and gray versions. Confirm the selected finish and configuration when requesting a sample.
